annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because the speaker promotes a pre-launch program in which $99 in Bitcoin secures a binary position, and an additional pool-unit purchase is required to obtain a referral link. The pitch ties commissions to referred purchases and describes a founders’ pool share of mined coins using prospective daily earnings examples, not realized payouts.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The speaker links purchased pool units to a proposed share of mined coins and illustrates recurring earnings from that share. The speaker links paid qualification to a referral link and describes commissions from purchases made through referrals, alongside a paid binary position.
